infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow LM Agent to access your camera to photograph Form 34A as required evidence for election result submissions.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow LM Agent to record your GPS location when submitting results to verify your presence at the polling station.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow LM Agent to access your photo library to attach Form 34A photos.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Allow LM Agent to use Face ID so you can sign in quickly without typing your password on election day.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow LM Agent to access your photos to attach Form 34A images.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow LM Agent to access your camera to photograph Form 34A.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow LM Agent to record your location when submitting election results.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow LM Agent to record your GPS location for result submission verification.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow LM Agent to use Face ID so you can sign in quickly without typing your password on election day.
